questions.question: Which framework is the right first pick for a workflow that must resume after a crash, accept a human approval mid-run, and fan out to three retrievers in parallel?
Why does LLM-selected routing cost more tokens per turn than explicit routing?
options: A planner LLM call picks the next step each turn, adding prompt and completion tokens for every decision.
It duplicates the tool list for every agent in the crew.
It sends the whole conversation history to a verifier model.
It pre-fetches the next node in parallel to hedge latency.

questions.question: Proposer-critic dialogue in code review naturally maps to which framework's core abstraction?
Which framework has built-in storage drivers (SQLite, Postgres, Redis, Mongo, DynamoDB) attached directly to the Agent class for session and memory persistence?
You have a two-call summarizer: fetch text, summarize. Which option is the right framework choice?
options: AutoGen GroupChat — two agents can argue about the best summary.
Plain Python with the provider SDK — no framework is the fastest framework for tiny pipelines.
CrewAI with researcher + summarizer roles — roles make it clearer.
LangGraph StateGraph — always use a framework for reliability.
